about_short_description.short_description: Blnk is a fintech firm that provides lending, financing, affordability, commission, reporting and settlement, and e-commerce services.

product.name: In-Store Financing Solution
product.description: A digital consumer finance service allowing customers to obtain instant loan approval using only their National ID to pay for purchases in installments up to 36 months at partner merchants.

product.name: Consumer Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app for consumers to manage their loans, track payments, receive notifications, and access merchant network information related to their financing.

product.name: Merchant Network Partnership
product.description: A network of retail and service merchants partnered with Blnk to offer point-of-sale financing options to consumers within Egypt.
